main_text.p: ut scilicet pergant & corruant retrorsum, conterantur,irretiantur & capiantur. Propterea audite uerbum Domini uiri illusores, qui dominamini populo huic, qui est in Ierusalē. Quia dixistis: Percusimus fœdus cum morte, & cū inferno fecimus(paciscendo) uisionem: & si flagellum uehemens transierit,non venietad nos: quoniā posuimus mendacium refugium nostrum, & sub vanitate abscondimur. Idcirco sic dicit Dominus Deus:Ecce ego pono pro fundamento in Zion lapidem,lapidem probatum, angulum preciosum, fundamentum solidum:qui credit,non festinet.Et ponam iudicium ad regulam,& iustitiam ad trutinam, & quasi scopa amouebit grando fiduciam vanam, & latibulum (refugij ueltri) aquæ sua inundatione implebūt.Et diluetur pactum vestrū cum morte (factum,) & visio vestra cum inferno(habita)non cō[?]surget: sed & flagellum uehemens si transierit, eritis sub eius coculcatione.Ab eo(tempo-re)quo illud pertransierit,arripiet vos: nam mane per singulos dies,imo die & nocte transibit:& erit,ut etiam eius auditus perceptus commotionem(incutiat.)Contractus enim est lectus,& non redundat,& operto-rium

page.notes: The line "utfcilicet" is set without a visible space; read as "ut scilicet". The word "cōsurget" is split across the line as "cofur get"; the reading is uncertain. The text is treated as one paragraph continuing from the previous page, since no indent is visible. Some letters (for example "ueltri", "trasibit") are copied as printed and may be printing errors. Long s has been replaced by plain s throughout.
